title: @dsar/cli
description: Command-line interface for DSAR APIs with endpoint parity coverage.
usage: Interactive mode (no args): `dsar` opens a wizard to choose command domain + command, prompt for params/payloads, and show review with execute/edit/cancel.

Configuration: same auth/env as Node SDK — DSAR_API_URL (required unless --api-url), DSAR_API_TOKEN (optional). Global flags: --api-url, --token, --idempotency-key, --output text|json, --json '<payload>'. --help prints help and does not start the wizard.
Output: --output text for readable; --output json for envelope { ok, data|error, meta }.

Commands mirror backend: init, status; subjects get; policies list|upgrades ...; requests ... (capture, clock explain, verification, delivery, manifest, appeals, audit); tenants retention get|put. See docs/developer/cli.md for full mapping.
npx dsar works only after package publishing; in-workspace use local install or workspace scripts.

commands.name: dsar --help
commands.description: Print help (does not start interactive wizard).

commands.name: dsar
commands.description: Start interactive command wizard when no arguments provided.
